data.gender_notes: Injila is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Injilah means 'news' or 'message' in Arabic. It is derived from the Arabic root 'n-j-l', which translates to 'to send, to deliver, or to announce'. Injila is a significant term in Islamic tradition, referring to the Gospel or the scripture sent to the People of the Book (Christians and Jews) by God. The name Injila carries the meaning “News, message, announcement” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Injila usually hope their child will grow to embody news, message, announcement and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Injila total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
